bools.name: dknSizeVariable

bools.name: dknModesNil
bools.comment: the attack and defense modes - the nil of both columns (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknOutwardManifestations
bools.comment: the nature - the outward manifestations of the powers of various plants and inanimate objects found in nature (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknLesserOfTreesFlowersRocksBamboo
bools.comment: the lesser kinds - the spirits of trees, flowers, rocks, and bamboo groves (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknGreaterOfMountainsBouldersPlainsIslands
bools.comment: the greater kinds - those of mountains, boulders, plains, extremely ancient trees, and small islands (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknLifeforceObjectOrPlace
bools.comment: the binding - all are associated with a particular object or place from which they derive their life force (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknDamageAffectsSpirit
bools.comment: the sympathy - damage done to the thing or place affects the spirit accordingly (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknTreeDeathKillsLesser
bools.comment: the lesser example - cutting down the tree which is the lifeforce of a lesser nature spirit would cause the death of that spirit (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknEarthquakeMayAngerOrInjure
bools.comment: the greater example - an earthquake which strikes the mountain of a greater nature spirit may anger or injure it, depending on the havoc wreaked (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknTwoAspects
bools.comment: the two aspects - they are all possessed of a good and an evil aspect (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknGoodAspectGentle
bools.comment: the good aspect - it leads the spirit to be gentle, helpful, and kind (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknEvilAspectMalicious
bools.comment: the evil aspect - it causes the spirit to be malicious, savage, and cruel (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknShunsMortalWorld
bools.comment: the seclusion - normally the spirit shuns contact with the mortal world, preferring to peacefully reside within the thing or place that forms its lifeforce (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknAppearsInDanger
bools.comment: the manifestation clause - in times of danger the nature spirit manifests itself (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknMeetsPeopleOfRenown
bools.comment: the testing clause - they often appear to meet or test people of renown and fame (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dknCommonInvisible
bools.comment: the first common power - become invisible (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknCommonPolymorphSelf
bools.comment: the second common power - polymorph self (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknCommonDetectEvilGood
bools.comment: the third common power - detect evil and good (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknCommonDetectMagic
bools.comment: the fourth common power - detect magic (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknCommonDetectHarmony
bools.comment: the fifth common power - detect harmony (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknCommonOncePerRoundAtWill
bools.comment: the use rate - the common powers are usable once per round at will (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknLesserFoundNearLifeforce
bools.comment: the lesser haunt - most often encountered in the vicinity of their lifeforce (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknLesserPolymorphedForm
bools.comment: the lesser look - when encountered usually polymorphed into the form of a handsome man or beautiful maiden (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknLesserCompleteAreaKnowledge
bools.comment: the lesser knowledge - complete knowledge of the area around their lifeforce (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknLesserFindsTreasuresAndLostItems
bools.comment: the lesser gift - able to find hidden treasures and lost items in that area without difficulty (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknLesserNoAbilitiesBeyond
bools.comment: the lesser limit - they possess no special abilities beyond those already listed (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknLesserMarriesMortals
bools.comment: the lesser romance - not uncommon for one to become attracted to and marry a mortal, such romances forming the basis for many tales and legends (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterConsiderablyMorePowerful
bools.comment: the greater standing - considerably more powerful than those of the lesser kind (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterKnowHistoryAura
bools.comment: the greater at-will powers - know history and aura at will (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterRewardOncePerWeek
bools.comment: the greater weekly reward - reward once per week (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterAncientCurseOncePerWeek
bools.comment: the greater weekly curse - ancient curse once per week (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterCastsElementSpells
bools.comment: the element spellcasting - able to cast all wu jen spells of the element of their lifeforce, except conjure elemental, once per day (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterMountainEarthSpells
bools.comment: the mountain example - a greater mountain spirit can cast all earth-related spells (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterIslandWaterSpells
bools.comment: the island example - a greater island spirit could cast all water-related spells, the water more dominant than the land in this case (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterPlusFourWeaponsOnly
bools.comment: the greater weapon floor - they can only be struck by +4 weapons or better (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterImmuneToOwnElement
bools.comment: the greater immunity - immune to magical attacks made using their element (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterCompleteEventKnowledge
bools.comment: the greater knowledge - complete knowledge of all events and happenings within the area of their lifeforce (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterAloofHaughtyIrritable
bools.comment: the greater temper - tend to be aloof, haughty, and irritable (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterSlopeVillageDisdain
bools.comment: the slope example - should a village be built on a prominent mountain slope the mountain spirit may think ill of it and attempt to drive the settlers off (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknMortalsOfferAndConsultShukenja
bools.comment: the mortal caution - mortals go to great pains to avoid upsetting them, presenting offerings and consulting shukenja before undertaking any enterprise which might upset the being (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dknGreaterSeldomIntermarry
bools.comment: the greater marriage clause - the greater nature spirits seldom intermarry with humans (print capture p. 279)
